# Game Idea: Canvas Dodger

- Player controls a small square moving left/right at the bottom of the canvas.
- Random obstacles (larger squares) fall from the top at varying speeds.
- Avoid collisions; optionally tap/press to boost movement.
- **Lose condition:** an obstacle hits the player or reaches the bottom after passing the player.
- Simple graphics and physics, perfect for an HTML5 canvas implementation.

1: // Simple Canvas Dodger game
2: // Canvas element with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   // Audio setup
6:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
7:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
8:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
9:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
10:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
11:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
12:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
13:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
14:     oscillator.start();
15:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
16:   };
17:   const playCollision = () => playTone(150, 0.3);
18:   const playScore = () => playTone(400, 0.1);
19:   const playBoost = () => playTone(600, 0.05);
20:   const playGameOver = () => playTone(80, 0.6);
21:   // Ensure audio context resumes on first interaction
22:   const resumeAudio = () => {
23:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
24:     window.removeEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio);
25:     window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', resumeAudio);
26:     canvas.removeEventListener('pointerdown', resumeAudio);
27:   };
28:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio);
29:   window.addEventListener('pointerdown', resumeAudio);
30:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', resumeAudio);
31: 
32:   if (!canvas) {
33:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
34:     return;
35:   }
36:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
37:   const width = canvas.width;
38:   const height = canvas.height;
39: 
40:   // Player configuration
41:   const player = {
42:     w: 30,
43:     h: 30,
44:     x: width / 2 - 15,
45:     y: height - 40,
46:     speed: 5,
47:     color: '#0a84ff',
48:     moveLeft: false,
49:     moveRight: false,
50:   };
51: 
52:   // Obstacles collection
53:   const obstacles = [];
54:   const particles = [];
55:   const obstacleConfig = {
56:     w: 40,
57:     h: 40,
58:     minSpeed: 2,
59:     maxSpeed: 6,
60:     spawnInterval: 1000, // ms
61:     color: '#ff3b30',
62:   };
63: 
64:   let lastSpawn = 0;
65:   let gameOver = false;
66:   let score = 0;
67: 
68:   // Input handling (keyboard arrow keys & A/D)
69:   const setKey = (e, down) => {
70:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') player.moveLeft = down;
71:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') player.moveRight = down;
72:   };
73:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => setKey(e, true));
74:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => setKey(e, false));
75: 
76:   // Touch / click to boost movement (optional)
77:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => { player.speed = 8; playBoost(); });
78:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', () => (player.speed = 5));
79: 
80:   // Spawn a new obstacle at a random x position
81:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
82:     const x = Math.random() * (width - obstacleConfig.w);
83:     const speed = obstacleConfig.minSpeed + Math.random() * (obstacleConfig.maxSpeed - obstacleConfig.minSpeed);
84:     obstacles.push({ x, y: -obstacleConfig.h, w: obstacleConfig.w, h: obstacleConfig.h, speed });
85:   };
86: 
87:   // Spawn a particle for effects
88:   const spawnParticle = (x, y) => {
89:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
90:     const speed = Math.random() * 2 + 0.5;
91:     particles.push({
92:       x,
93:       y,
94:       vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
95:       vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
96:       radius: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
97:       alpha: 1,
98:       decay: Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.01,
99:     });
100:   };
101: 
102:     const x = Math.random() * (width - obstacleConfig.w);
103:     const speed = obstacleConfig.minSpeed + Math.random() * (obstacleConfig.maxSpeed - obstacleConfig.minSpeed);
104:     obstacles.push({ x, y: -obstacleConfig.h, w: obstacleConfig.w, h: obstacleConfig.h, speed });
105:   };
106: 
107:   // Simple rectangle collision detection
108:   const collides = (a, b) =>
109:     a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
110: 
111:   // Game loop
112:   const update = (timestamp) => {
113:     if (gameOver) return;
114:     // Clear canvas with gradient background
115:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
116:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
117:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003');
118:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
119:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
120: 
121:     // Update player position
122:     if (player.moveLeft) player.x = Math.max(0, player.x - player.speed);
123:     if (player.moveRight) player.x = Math.min(width - player.w, player.x + player.speed);
124: 
125:     // Draw player with gradient and rounded corners
126:     const playerGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, player.y, 0, player.y + player.h);
127:     playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0cf');
128:     playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#06c');
129:     ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
130:     const r = 6; // corner radius
131:     ctx.beginPath();
132:     ctx.moveTo(player.x + r, player.y);
133:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w - r, player.y);
134:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y, player.x + player.w, player.y + r);
135:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h - r);
136:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h, player.x + player.w - r, player.y + player.h);
137:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + r, player.y + player.h);
138:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h, player.x, player.y + player.h - r);
139:     ctx.lineTo(player.x, player.y + r);
140:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y, player.x + r, player.y);
141:     ctx.closePath();
142:     ctx.fill();
143: 
144:     // Spawn obstacles based on interval
145:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > obstacleConfig.spawnInterval) {
146:       spawnObstacle();
147:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
148:     }
149: 
150:     // Update and draw obstacles with gradient and rounded corners
151:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
152:       const o = obstacles[i];
153:       o.y += o.speed;
154:       const obsGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x + o.w/2, o.y + o.h/2, o.w/4, o.x + o.w/2, o.y + o.h/2, o.w/2);
155:       obsGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff7b7b');
156:       obsGrad.addColorStop(1, '#c40000');
157:       ctx.fillStyle = obsGrad;
158:       const r = 4;
159:       ctx.beginPath();
160:       ctx.moveTo(o.x + r, o.y);
161:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w - r, o.y);
162:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x + o.w, o.y, o.x + o.w, o.y + r);
163:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h - r);
164:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h, o.x + o.w - r, o.y + o.h);
165:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + r, o.y + o.h);
166:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x, o.y + o.h, o.x, o.y + o.h - r);
167:       ctx.lineTo(o.x, o.y + r);
168:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x, o.y, o.x + r, o.y);
169:       ctx.closePath();
170:       ctx.fill();
171: 
172:       // Collision detection
173:       if (collides(player, o)) {
174:         gameOver = true;
175:         playCollision();
176:         // spawn burst particles on collision
177:         for (let p = 0; p < 12; p++) spawnParticle(o.x + o.w/2, o.y + o.h/2);
178:         break;
179:       }
180: 
181:       // Remove if off-screen (score and particle effect)
182:       if (o.y > height) {
183:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
184:         score++;
185:         playScore();
186:         // small burst when obstacle passes
187:         for (let p = 0; p < 6; p++) spawnParticle(o.x + o.w/2, height);
188:       }
189:     }
190: 
191:     // Lose condition: obstacle reaches bottom after passing player
192:     if (!gameOver) {
193:       const passed = obstacles.some(o => o.y + o.h >= height);
194:       if (passed) gameOver = true;
195:     }
196: 
197:     // Draw game over overlay
198:     if (gameOver) {
199:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
200:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
201:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
202:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
203:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
204:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
205:     } else {
206:       // Continue loop
207:       requestAnimationFrame(update);
208:     }
209:   };
210: 
211:   // Start the loop
212:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
213: })();
